verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway is designed to work with official SDKs (OpenAI client libraries, Anthropic SDK, Vercel AI SDK) via URL/base-URL swaps with no rewrites, and provides an OpenAPI spec and models endpoint for programmatic/SDK-based integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of SDK compatibility across all providers, and dedicated first-party SDK packages beyond OpenAI-compatible client reuse.
